fields.title: Blibli homepage feed tile
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of Blibli's own internal API JSON. Every field Blibli returns is preserved verbatim; fields prefixed with `_` are added by this actor -- the standard portfolio envelope plus flattened conveniences (price, discount, ad-banner details, rank) that a consumer would otherwise have to dig out of nested containers. A row is one of three tile types, told apart by `_recordType`: 'product' (carries `sku`/`name`/`price`), 'ad_banner' (carries `promoBannerInfo`), or 'category_card' (a curated 'trending now' collection tile linking to a category landing page, carries `cardLabel`/`cardDescription` but no `sku`).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The tab short-code (e.g. TAB_1) that produced this record.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed or empty runs (BLOCKED_AFTER_RETRIES, UPSTREAM_SHAPE_CHANGED, INVALID_INPUT, EMPTY_RESULT).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_tabName.title: Tab code
_tabName.description: Short tab identifier used to query the feed, e.g. TAB_1.

_tabTitle.title: Tab title
_tabTitle.description: Human-readable tab label as shown on the homepage, e.g. 'Untukmu', 'Zona affiliate', 'Handuk'.

_tabSourceType.title: Tab source type
_tabSourceType.description: MANUAL (editorially curated tab, e.g. For You / affiliate zone) or AUTOMATIC (algorithmically generated category tab).

_recordType.title: Record type
_recordType.description: 'product' (a real product recommendation), 'ad_banner' (a paid brand-ad slot interleaved with recommendations), 'category_card' (a curated 'trending now' collection tile linking to a category page), or 'unknown' (a genuinely unrecognised tile shape, emitted rather than dropped).

_rankInFeed.title: Rank in feed
_rankInFeed.description: 1-based position of this tile within the tab's sweep, in the order Blibli returned it. Note: the upstream `sequence` field is not reliable for this (observed always 0); this is the actor's own running count.

_page.title: Page
_page.description: Which page of the feed this tile came from.

_productUrl.title: Product / card URL
_productUrl.description: Absolute blibli.com URL the tile links to. Product and category_card records only; ad banners use _adRedirectUrl instead.

_cardLabel.title: Card label
_cardLabel.description: Badge text on a category_card tile, e.g. 'Lagi laris' (trending now). Category card records only.

_cardDescription.title: Card description
_cardDescription.description: Supporting text on a category_card tile, e.g. '1,7 rb terjual bulan ini' (1.7k sold this month) -- a sales-velocity signal for that category. Category card records only.

_listPrice.title: List price (IDR)
_listPrice.description: Pre-discount price in rupiah. Product records only; often absent when the tile has no discount (0%).

_offerPrice.title: Offer price (IDR)
_offerPrice.description: Current selling price in rupiah. Product records only.

_discountPercent.title: Discount %
_discountPercent.description: Headline discount off list price. Product records only; recomputed from list/offer price on the rare row where Blibli omits the field, per the pattern documented across this portfolio.

_discountSource.title: Discount provenance
_discountSource.description: 'upstream' when Blibli published the discount figure itself, 'computed' when derived from list vs offer price.

_savingAmount.title: Saving (IDR)
_savingAmount.description: List price minus offer price, in rupiah. Product records only.

_contextualDiscountPercent.title: Contextual discount %
_contextualDiscountPercent.description: Discount after stacking payment-method/voucher promos, when Blibli exposes one. Product records only.

_brandAdId.title: Ad id
_brandAdId.description: Blibli's internal id for the ad campaign behind this banner slot. Ad banner records only.

_adBrandNames.title: Ad brand names
_adBrandNames.description: Brand(s) the banner promotes. Ad banner records only.

_adRedirectUrl.title: Ad redirect URL
_adRedirectUrl.description: Absolute blibli.com landing page the banner links to. Ad banner records only.

_adStartTime.title: Ad campaign start
_adStartTime.description: UTC ISO 8601. Ad banner records only.

_adEndTime.title: Ad campaign end
_adEndTime.description: UTC ISO 8601. Ad banner records only.

_personalizationSource.title: Personalization source
_personalizationSource.description: Which internal recommendation service produced this tile, e.g. 'brs' (Blibli Recommendation Service).

_personalizationLogic.title: Personalization logic
_personalizationLogic.description: Upstream's own tag for the ranking logic applied, e.g. 'DEFAULT_RERANK'. Algorithm-intelligence signal, passed through verbatim.

_strategyId.title: Strategy id
_strategyId.description: Upstream's internal recommendation-strategy identifier for this tile.
